Fight Caves Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Fight Caves in less than 30 minutes.\nStrategy:\nFor strategies on this achievement, see Fight Caves Speed-Runner.

Fight Caves Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Fight Caves in less than 26 minutes and 30 seconds.
Strategy:
It is highly advised to use rotation 5 if going for this achievement due to it having the best spawns (e.g. wave 62 has both magers spawn close together), although any rotation may be used if learned well enough.
While doing the run itself is relatively simple, there are many minor time saves that should be used throughout:
- Drink a dose of stamina potion, divine super combat potion, and divine ranging potion before entering. The boost from an imbued heart or saturated heart may also be used for slightly longer thralls during the initial waves, although this is optional.
- Roughly memorising the spawns of each wave as well as where to stand at the beginning of each wave will help greatly in dealing with every wave properly. The Fight Caves Spawn Predictor plugin on RuneLite's Plugin Hub is especially helpful, as it has an option to display the next wave's spawns.
- Stand in between the spawn point of the high-HP NPCs and the rest of the NPCs (while still being close enough to attack). When the wave starts, begin attacking and dragging the high-HP NPC towards the weaker NPCs.
- Killing the large blobs early in the wave allows you to attack something else while waiting for them to split into the two bloblets.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Chitin Penetrator is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kalphite Queen while her defence was last lowered by the player.
Strategy:
This task can most reliably be completed by using a special attack from the bone dagger or crossbow, which are guaranteed to hit if used as the first attack on the Kalphite Queen. However, the following special attacks all drain defence upon a successful hit and can be used:
- Darklight
- Arclight
- Emberlight
- Bandos godsword
- Dragon warhammer
- Elder maul
- Barrelchest anchor
- Accursed sceptre
- Tonalztics of Ralos
Additionally, successful attacks with the following also drain defence:
- Claws of guthix
- Any shadow spell with the Shadow ancient sceptre
- Curse or Vulnerability
If attacked by the Kalphite Queen, the following items both have a chance to drain defence levels, if Kalphite Queen still has more than half of her health, assuming they are charged:
- Black mask
- Any weapon while a Broodoo shield (poison) is equipped, and only if damaged by the Kalphite Queen

Insect Deflection is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kalphite Queen by using the Vengeance spell as the finishing blow.\nAnother account can cast Vengeance Other on the player and it will count toward this combat achievement.

Prayer Smasher is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kalphite Queen using only Verac's flail as a weapon. Inflicting recoil damage with a ring of recoil, ring of suffering, echo boots, or Vengeance is not allowed. This has to be done solo; damage from another player will invalidate the kill even if they are also using a flail. However, damage from thralls and poison inflicted via the serpentine helm are allowed, and the kill can be completed over several trips.
Strategy:
The entire Verac's set is not needed to complete the task, only the flail, though the set effect makes it stronger than some mid and lower level setups even while on task. If not using the full set, strength bonus and crush attack bonus should be prioritised. Kalphite tasks can be assigned by any Slayer master other than Krystilia and Mortimer for the Slayer helmet or black mask bonus. Alternatively, the serpentine helm can be used for its poison chance, allowing you to wait out the poison and avoid taking hits from the Kalphite Queen.
Flail-less strategy:
It is also possible to complete this achievement without the use of a Verac's flail at all if A Kingdom Divided has been completed. The task will complete if the Kalphite Queen is killed using only magic thralls.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Claw Clipper is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the King Black Dragon with the Protect from Melee prayer activated. This combat achievement will only be completed if Protect from Melee is the only activated prayer and it must remain activated until the player gets credit for the kill. Turn off all other prayers before finishing the kill.

Hide Penetration is a medium combat achievement requiring the player to kill the King Black Dragon with a weapon using the stab attack style.\nStrategy:\nThe weapon only needs to be equipped for the final hit. The weapon must be set to the stab attack style.

Antifire Protection is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the King Black Dragon with an antifire potion active and an antidragon shield equipped.\nThe dragonfire shield, dragonfire ward, or ancient wyvern shield can be used as alternatives for completing the achievement.

Who Is the King Now? is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the King Black Dragon 10 times in a private instance without leaving.
Strategies:
The following adjustments may be desired:
General:
- Thralls will provide damage that bypasses the King Black Dragon's exceptional defence, allowing for relatively faster kills and less time tanking breath attacks. It is recommended to only bring exactly as many runes as needed (10-15 casts worth) to minimise risk on death in the Wilderness. This consumes inventory slots that could otherwise be used for food.
- Due to constant damage, a ring of suffering may provide better damage per second than any other ring that can be chosen, for similar reasons as thralls, along with providing significant prayer bonus. However, it will require consideration if it is risked.
- Praying Rapid heal will generate additional health, though not much, likely equivalent to one unit of food over the entire trip. A regen bracelet can assist further, but depending on what items are protected, it may not be worth the loss of damage.
- If a friend or an alt can scout the route to the lair, it may reduce risk within the Wilderness, allowing more powerful gear that goes beyond four risked items. This under no circumstances guarantees total safety, especially if forced to make multiple trips to try again after a failure.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)
Unnecessary Optimisation is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kraken after killing all four tentacles.\nThe Enormous Tentacles can be killed before waking the Kraken.

Krakan't Hurt Me is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kraken 25 times in a private instance without leaving or logging out.\nStrategy:\nPlayers should bring a full inventory of high healing food and the best magic defence equipment available. A trident of the seas or swamp should be enough to complete the achievement on its own, but additional blood spells can help recover hitpoints in a pinch.

Ten-tacles is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kraken 50 times in a private instance without leaving or logging out.
Strategy:
The combat achievement is only possible on a cave kraken or Kraken boss Slayer assignment of at least 50 kills. Players should bring a full inventory of high healing food and their best magic defence equipment. A trident of the seas or swamp should be enough to complete the achievement on its own, but additional blood spells can help recover hitpoints in a pinch. It is possible to use blood spells on the whirlpool to heal in between kills without being attacked, and can be utilised as many times as desired between kills.
Note: While the Kraken can drop cooked sharks when killed, the drop rate for them may not be enough to sustain the given kill count. The achievement is possible with good food and enough shark drops from it, but blood spells provide much more reliable healing.
It will take roughly one hour to complete the achievement with decent gear and by casting blood spells on the whirlpool.

One Hundred Tentacles is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Kraken a hundred times in a single trip in a private instance without leaving or logging out.
Strategy:
Due to the fact that the Kraken can only be fought on task, the combat achievement requires getting a task from either Nieve, Steve, Duradel, or Kuradal for a guaranteed task of at least 100 kills. Konar quo Maten can also give the required amount as her maximum amount. Using the Krack on Slayer task extension will additionally allow both Konar and Chaeldar to be guaranteed to assign the required amount. Bracelets of slaughter can also be used to increase the effective amount of shorter tasks.
It is recommended to bring runes for blood spells as a means of healing as the Kraken's supply drops are not reliable enough to obtain the achievement. Blood spells can be cast on the Kraken while it is submerged without waking it for infinite healing between kills. A Sanguinesti staff will help during kills, or another weapon that can auto-cast ancient magic is beneficial such as the Ancient staff to avoid the need to manually cast repeatedly. If using blood spells, it could be beneficial to bring an Explorer's ring to cast high/low alchemy.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Master of Broad Weaponry is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill a kurask.\nKilling a kurask requires level 70 Slayer. Players must also have leaf-bladed weaponry to kill it. This includes broad ammunition and the Magic Dart spell (requiring a Slayer's staff).\nNote: The kurask in the southern cave of the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon can only be harmed while on a kurask Slayer task.

Shayzien Protector is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill a lizardman shaman in Molch which has not dealt damage to anyone, excluding the damage that its spawns deal.\nStrategy:\nFull Shayzien armour (tier 5) is required to prevent damage from the special attack. One option is to pray Protect from Missiles and use a range attack, such as the Toxic blowpipe, to keep distance from the lizardman shaman.

Mimic Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Mimic once.\nIn order to be eligible to obtain a Mimic, players must first speak to the strange casket upstairs in Watson's house in Hosidius to enable the chance of a reward casket turning into the Mimic. An elite reward casket has a 1/35 chance of being a mimic, while master reward caskets have a 1/15 chance. There is a one-time guaranteed Mimic encounter on either the 10th master or 25th elite casket, whichever is first.

Why Are You Running? is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Giant Mole without her burrowing more than two times.
Strategy:
After reaching half health (100 HP), each attack the Giant Mole takes may prompt her to dig away to another location in her lair. Circumvent this by using Dharok the Wretched's equipment while staying at low health.
Additionally, by using a superpoisoned weapon, the poison will deal enough damage to kill the mole without her burrowing, provided the final attack reduces her health below 100. Regular weapon poison is a poor choice for this technique, as it only does 50 damage in total before expiring, and considering that even successful melee hits only have a 25% chance of poisoning, it will be unlikely that the player can poison the mole again before she burrows several times.
For Ironmen, who typically do not have access to weapon poison(++) due to the high Herblore level requirement, a great alternative is completing the Tai Bwo Wannai Trio quest and speaking to Tamayu, who will reward the player with a rune spear(kp). This karambwan-poison-coated weapon has the same poison strength as weapon poison(++).

Hard Hitter is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Giant Mole within four hits that deal damage.
Strategy:
Misses (0 hitsplat) do not count towards the 4 or less hits. The giant mole has 200 Hitpoints, so each hit must deal an average of 50 damage to complete the task. The easiest method is to use Dharok the Wretched's equipment with 1 Hitpoints, a higher Hitpoints level will increase damage, and the highest melee strength items possible — an amulet of rancour, amulet of torture, or amulet of strength, Avernic treads (max) (dragon boots are acceptable), a fire cape/infernal cape or equivalents and barrows/ferocious gloves to hit as hard as possible. The Soulreaper axe will also provide similar possible outcome.
Use the aggressive hack-slash combat option on the Dharok's greataxe against the mole's slightly lower slash Defence compared to crush Defence.
Without access to Dharok's, another option is to use a high hitting special attack weapon with a single hitsplat (Armadyl godsword, Bandos godsword, dragon warhammer, Voidwaker etc.) and teleporting to a player-owned house to recharge special attack energy so that the only 4 hits on the boss are special attacks. If the first 2 hits are not high enough, either kill the boss normally or hop worlds to reset the task.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Whack-a-Mole is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Giant Mole within 10 seconds of her resurfacing.
Strategy:
The easiest way to complete this achievement is to use a multi-hit weapon that deals damage on separate ticks, as the first hit can cause the mole to dig, applying the second hit immediately when the mole resurfaces. The best option is the Twinflame staff; the mole never digs on splashed magic attacks, so this guarantees a resurface hit on every dig. Some multi-hit special attacks, such as the crystal or dragon halberd, dragon claws, or dragon dagger (p++) also work. Note that a dark bow will not work, as the mole's digging will null the second hit splat. The viability of other multi-hit weapons not listed here has not yet been confirmed.
Another viable option is to use venom or poison. One could time it to use a fast-hitting weapon such as knives right before the venom ticks in an attempt to force the mole to dig. Alternatively, players going for the 25 kill count combat achievement may simply wish to wait and hope to kill the mole after it resurfaces close to them.

Avoiding Those Little Arms is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Giant Mole without anyone taking damage from her.\nStrategy:\nThe Giant Mole only attacks with melee. If melee is being used against the Giant Mole, Protect from Melee can be activated to negate all damage. Otherwise, Ranged or Magic can be used while using Protect from Melee, or while safespotting the Giant Mole on corners of the wall in the Mole Hole.
Nightmare Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat The Nightmare 25 times. Phosani's Nightmare kills will also count towards this achievement.
Nightmare Master is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat The Nightmare 50 times. Phosani's Nightmare kills will also count towards this achievement.

Terrible Parent is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill The Nightmare in a solo encounter without the Parasites healing her for over 100 health.
Strategy:
Parasites only appear in phase 2, so clearing it quickly will prevent too many of them from spawning, though the phase itself can take quite a while due to the Nightmare's durable shield and totems. The parasite will burst from the player in 4-5 of their attacks (depending on weapon used), so it is recommended to walk underneath the Nightmare so that the parasite will not be able to heal her right away.
Drinking Relicym's balm or Sanfew serum is required before the parasite spawns as it will reduce their combat stats significantly, making them easier to kill. The parasite will have 40 health.
Several alternative methods may be more efficient, such as stepping under the parasites and attacking with the dragon claws or crimson kisten special attack, since unlike its hard mode variant, weapons on crush will not max hit the parasite.
Additional options for dealing high damage per second include the following weapons and their respective special attacks:
- Elder maul
- Granite maul
- Dragon dagger(p++)
- Dragon mace
- Voidwaker

Explosion! is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill two Husks at the same time.
Strategy:
A dragon 2h sword or Dinh's bulwark special attack or a standard attack from Hallowfell, when targeted on the Nightmare, should kill both husks immediately. Husks have 20 hitpoints. Barrage spells or chinchompas can also work if the player doesn't have access to either weapon, though the husks are much more resistant to both styles. As a last resort for Ironmen, the husks can be weakened, then finished off with the special attack from a Rune thrownaxe, though this method is much less consistent and may take multiple attempts. Using the prayer Retribution also triggers completion, if you weaken the husks beforehand.
Note: Even though Husks also appear in Phosani's Nightmare, this achievement is only completable in Phase 1 of The Nightmare.

Perfect Nightmare is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Nightmare without any player taking damage from the following attacks: Nightmare rifts, an un-cured parasite explosion, Corpse flowers or the Nightmare's Surge. Also, no player can take damage off prayer or have their attacks slowed by the Nightmare spores.

Sleep Tight is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Nightmare solo. Due to the Nightmare's constant chip damage, an amulet of blood fury is strongly recommended to complete it.

A Long Trip is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires The Nightmare to be defeated with all players in the fight not losing any prayer points.
Strategy:
Prayer flicking is recommended to speed up the kill and take minimal damage as the Nightmare's attacks will deal higher damage if not prayed against. While completable solo, it is recommended to attempt the achievement in groups as they result in a faster kill.
It is not recommended to flick stat-boosting prayers alongside protection prayers, as they generally have a higher drain rate compared to protection prayers and a single mistake will disqualify the entire team from the achievement.
Lastly, summoning thralls (which drains prayer points) will not disqualify players.

Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Trialist elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare, solo, in under 23 minutes.\nStrategy:\nFor strategies on this achievement, see Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Runner.

Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare, solo, in under 19 minutes.\nStrategy:\nFor strategies on this achievement, see Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Runner.

Nightmare (Solo) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare in a solo encounter within 16 minutes.
Strategy:
A Scythe of Vitur is the most powerful weapon for this task, but an Inquisitor's mace or Soulreaper axe are viable alternatives. The relatively low Defence and high Hitpoints of the boss make those weapons' extra accuracy less valuable than the scythe's increased amount of hits, but either weapon is still sufficient for an experienced player.
Eye of Ayak and ancestral robes are beneficial for inflicting extra damage to the totems, with Tumeken's shadow and Sanguinesti staff trailing close behind in DPS. The Arceuus spellbook's ghostly thralls deal double damage on the totems, and Death Charge can be used on husks, parasites, and sleepwalkers to restore special attack more frequently. Use Crimson kisten or Voidwaker specials against the Nightmare. Lightbearer is very useful for spec regeneration.

Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare in a team of 5 players in under 5 minutes.\nLike other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare in a team of 5 players in under 4 minutes.\nLike other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

Nightmare (5-Scale) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to defeat the Nightmare in a team of 5 players in under 3 minutes and 30 seconds.\nLike other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

From One King to Another is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Prime using a rune thrownaxe special attack, bounced off Dagannoth Rex.\nIronmen cannot receive help from other players to help tank the Kings.\nFor the task to count, the special attack must be the last attack made when Prime's death animation finishes.
A Frozen King is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Rex whilst he is immobilized. Curse spells, grasp spells, and ice spells count towards this achievement.

Toppling the Diarchy is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Dagannoth Rex and one other Dagannoth king at the exact same time.
Strategy:
The easiest method is to bring another player and attack Dagannoth Rex and a different king on the same tick, causing both to be dealt the killing blow at the same time. To make this even easier, the Voidwaker's special attack is guaranteed to deal at least 50% of the player's normal max hit, meaning using the special attack at the same time as the other player uses it will not leave your final hits up to chance.
For Ironmen and players who wish to complete the task solo, stack Dagannoth Rex and Dagannoth Prime on top of each other and kill them with the dragon crossbow's special attack. Alternatively, black chinchompas thrown at Dagannoth Prime have a similar, but slightly weaker effect. It's recommended to bring both in case the special attack misses. To ensure the best chance of this method working, bring runes for Entangle to keep Rex as close to death as possible, as it can only hit up to 5 damage.
In either case, ensure neither of the two kings move when lowering their hitpoints to 0, as this will cause their death animations to desync and will not grant the achievement.
Ensure you have kill credit on both Rex and the second Dagannoth king for the combat achievement to count.

Ready to Pounce is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sarachnis without her using her range attack twice in a row.
Strategy:
This achievement is most easily done with melee in a solo encounter as this makes Sarachnis' attacks very predictable. To avoid damage from her, players should stand in the centre of the room as she spawns (see image), activate Protect from Melee, and wait for her sticky web attack.
Aranea boots will easily allow the player to remain in melee distance, preventing any ranged attacks from occurring. Otherwise, standing in the area marked in the image will ensure players will only get hit once by her Ranged attack after her web attack, as players will be able to move within range of her melee attack from anywhere in the marked area. If done correctly, she should never be able to damage players off prayer, and should allow players to complete the Inspect Repellent achievement as well, if they haven't already completed it.

Inspect Repellent is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sarachnis without her dealing damage to anyone.
Strategy:
This achievement is most easily done with melee in a solo encounter, as this makes Sarachnis' attacks very predictable. To avoid damage from her, the player should stand in the centre of the room as she spawns, activate protect from melee, and wait for her sticky web attack. Once she says "Hsss!", the player should change to protect from missiles and start spam clicking her, and as soon as the player starts moving, change prayer back to protect from melee. If done correctly, she should only use her ranged attack once per web and complete the Ready to Pounce achievement as well.
Alternatively, the achievement can be completed by standing in the centre of the room using a halberd and praying protect from missiles. With running turned off, the player will not accidentally get within Sarachnis' melee range and can thus defeat her without ever switching prayers.
The Aranea boots are invaluable for this achievement. Players with access to the boots will bypass Sarachnis' sticky web every time and will only need to stay within melee range with protect from melee and running on. This method in a solo encounter is by far the easiest way to complete the achievement.
Taking damage from her spawns will not fail this achievement.

Newspaper Enthusiast is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sarachnis with a crush weapon.\nStrategy:\nOther weapons and combat styles can be used during the fight. Only the final blow has to be dealt using the crush attack style.

Commander Showdown is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to finish off Commander Zilyana while all of her bodyguards are dead.\nStrategy:\nA good method to complete this task solo, alongside the similar tasks for each of the respective God Wars Dungeon bosses, is to use a Toxic blowpipe alongside a Serpentine helm to envenom the bodyguards between kills, so that when the boss is low on health all of the minions are also low/dead, allowing them to be killed easier.

Animal Whisperer is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance without taking damage from either her or her bodyguards.
Strategy:
This achievement is fairly straightforward to achieve with the kiting method. A twisted bow or tumeken's shadow is encouraged to help speed up kills and reduce the amount of time needed to kill Zilyana. The kiting method will ensure that Starlight, the melee bodyguard, should never hit the player. This leaves Growler and Bree, the magic and ranged bodyguards respectively, as the only major threat. It is important to have the two hit on different ticks so their attacks can be protected against.
With some luck, it is possible to kill Zilyana before the bodyguard the player is not protecting against damages the player.
An alternative method to consider is killing either Growler or Bree just after Zilyana respawns, praying protection for the magic/ranged bodyguard that does respawn, then proceeding with the kiting method as normal. This allows time to kill Zilyana for this Combat Achievement without needing to change prayers.

Moving Collateral is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance without attacking her directly.
Strategy:
The inefficient nature of this achievement encourages setting up for a single kill run.
- Using chinchompas to hit Starlight (or other minions) is the fastest method, bypassing Zilyana's high defence via splash damage.
- The venator bow is a slower method, but can be used similarly on a minion near Zilyana to complete the achievement.
- Barrage spells can also be used, but are the most inefficient method due to Zilyana's high Magic level.
To avoid accidentally attacking Zilyana, use menu entry swapper to change Zilyana's default click option.
Rings of recoil or the ring of suffering will not fail the task, and can be used for additional damage during the kill.

Reminisce is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Commander Zilyana in a private instance using only melee.
Strategy:
The achievement is made much easier by running away from (or walking under) Zilyana after every hit, as her magic attack leaves her unable to move for a few seconds, allowing players to trade hits one-for-one despite her fast attack speed. Use Protect from Magic and an accurate melee weapon like Osmumten's fang, along with a defence-reducing special weapon, such as the elder maul or dragon warhammer. Ideally, Justiciar armour along with a spectral or elysian spirit shield should be used to greatly reduce damage taken from Zilyana's attacks.
Note: A ring of recoil, Vengeance, and other forms of damage reflection will fail this task. However, zombified thralls are allowed as they use melee. The Voidwaker's special attack will also cause the task to fail, as it is magic based.

Peach Conjurer is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Commander Zilyana 50 times in a private instance, without leaving the room. In order to attempt this task, players will need to have the Hard Combat Achievements done so that they are able to rent private instances.
Strategy:
Follow the typical strategies for fighting Zilyana in a solo encounter. Drops in a private instance (barring bones) will remain for 3 hours, more than enough for the achievement.
This task is significantly longer than any other God Wars kill count task, as Zilyana respawns 90 seconds after being killed. With 50 kills being required for the task, the spawn time alone will account for 73.5 minutes, and kill times can be fairly inconsistent, so players should expect to be staying for a minimum of at least two hours for the task. Due to this, it is highly recommended to use the bathroom before attempting the task and to avoid drinking too many fluids. If a bathroom break is necessary, it should be done during minion cleanup, autocasting Blood Barrage on minions to sustain health. Be sure to re-log/world hop before starting the attempt, in order to avoid potentially being six hour logged midway through the attempt.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

I Can't Reach That is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Scorpia without taking any damage from her. This can be done by using Protect from Melee throughout the fight.\nLeaving the cave to reset aggression does not fail the achievement.

Guardians No More is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Scorpia without killing her guardians.\nStrategy:\nScorpia's guardians will despawn when they have not healed Scorpia for 15 seconds and will not respawn for the rest of the fight. When the guardians spawn, cast either entangle, ice blitz, or ice barrage on both of them and then lure Scorpia to the other side of the room. If Scorpia is lured far enough, the guardians will despawn before reaching her. Blighted entangle sacks or blighted ancient ice sacks are cheap and convenient to use for this purpose.

Fragment of Seren Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement that requires the Fragment of Seren boss fight to be completed in less than four minutes. Completion of Song of the Elves is required to attempt this achievement as the fight during the quest does not count. The fight can be attempted at the Memoriam Device in Prifddinas.
Strategy:
Generally, hard foods such as fish or hunter meat should be avoided as the tick delay will consume a significant amount of time while recovering from Seren's special attacks. Saradomin brews could be used, however these drain stats and are not recommended.
Magic:
The key to this achievement is to maximise one’s Magic attack damage and bonus, as well as minimising disruption to attacking the Fragment, mainly eating. Players should also be able to quickly identify the real Fragment when she duplicates herself (being the lighter coloured shadow) as well as bringing a fast weapon, such as darts or blowpipe, to quickly dispose of the crystal whirlwinds to stop her from healing and also to resume attacking her. An accursed sceptre special attack at the beginning of each phase will reduce her defence and help speed up the kill. The Eye of Ayak is the best weapon to use due to its fast attack speed, which is affected less by the damage cap of 24 on the Fragment.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Snake Rebound is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah by using the Vengeance spell as the finishing blow.\nStrategy:\nKeep in mind that Vengeance has a 30 second cooldown, so plan accordingly. Make sure there are no snakelings present when setting up the kill, otherwise they might hit the player and waste the cast. Once Zulrah is at less than ~15 HP, cast vengeance before an attack hits. To help guarantee damage, the player can intentionally get hit by the tail whip attack during Zulrah's magma form, but must ensure that they are positioned away from any pillars as said pillars will cause the attack to miss. It is possible to use a ring of recoil or a ring of suffering (r) to help as well. The player does not need to survive Zulrah's final attack in order to obtain the achievement.

Snake. Snake!? Snaaaaaake! is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill 3 snakelings simultaneously while fighting Zulrah.
Strategy:
Zulrah will usually summon three to four snakelings at a time. The snakelings may either attack with melee or magic, so lure melee-using snakelings near magic ones and hit the pile with an instant damage area of effect attack, such as throwing a chinchompa, casting a burst/barrage spell, or attacking with Hallowfell. Toggle recoil off to avoid killing a snakeling, and try to pile them as quickly as possible as they will die off if left too long, even if in combat with the player.
Alternatively, this achievement can also be passively accomplished with your recoil ring eventually whilst fighting Zulrah. Be mindful not to accidentally die when you are unprepared to receive the achievement notification.

Perfect Zulrah is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah whilst taking no damage from the following: Snakelings, Venom Clouds, Zulrah's Green or Crimson phase.
Strategy:
To kill Zulrah without being hit, snakelings need to be killed as quickly as possible. They spawn as either melee or magic users, their high accuracy means that they are likely to hit if their attack is not protected against. Ensure distance is kept, pray Protect from Magic, and use a blowpipe to kill the snakelings as they spawn; their NPC IDs are different (with 2045 being the melee spawns, and 2046 being the magic spawns) so you can highlight them for quick differentiation. Strong defensive (ranged) gear and a defensive prayer will minimise chances of being hit off prayer. One or two well-timed Chinchompas can also take out a snakeling clump and allow the player to quickly continue killing the boss.
In general, killing the boss as quickly as possible reduces your chance of being hit by a snakeling, so following advice for achieving record times will maximize chances of completing this task. If resetting to complete this task by itself, players may find the green/ranged rotation to be beneficial to prioritise, as the snakelings spawn almost all together at the start of the kill, and many can be trapped on the far side of the shrine and killed safely from a distance.

Zulrah Speed-Trialist is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah in less than 1 minute 20 seconds, without a slayer task.\nStrategy:\nFor strategies on this achievement, see Zulrah Speed-Runner.

Zulrah Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement requiring the player to kill Zulrah in less than 1 minute, without a slayer task.\nStrategy:\nFor strategies on this achievement, see Zulrah Speed-Runner.

Zulrah Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Zulrah in less than 54 seconds without having it assigned as a slayer task.
Strategy:
As a fast speed-kill achievement, the player will want to use thralls, and all damage-boosting equipment and prayers available for both ranged and magic. Any hits that would deal over 50 damage to Zulrah will be reduced to 45-50 damage; however, this only applies to individual hitsplats, meaning a special attack from a weapon such as the crystal halberd will work around this damage cap.
Tumeken's shadow is recommended for Zulrah's ranged and melee forms (as the player will be very accurate despite the high Magic level, due to no Magic defence); for the mage form, a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts is recommended for rapid hits, in part due to the faster attack speed and Zulrah's damage cap. Vengeance can also be useful in rebounding damage back at Zulrah, provided that no Snakelings are present in the arena. As a finisher, the player can use a dark bow with dragon arrows, to expend special attack energy.
Alternatively, Oathplate armour in conjunction with a Noxious halberd and a Crystal halberd for special attacks may be used, as Zulrah possesses no additional melee defence. Furthermore an Eclipse atlatl can be brought to attack Zulrah for when Venom Clouds hinder you from getting close to Zulrah.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Rapid Succession is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill all three Dagannoth Kings within 9 seconds of the first one. Ironmen cannot use main accounts to help tank the Kings to complete this challenge.
Strategies:
Voidwaker:
The Voidwaker special attack is guaranteed to deal at least 50% of your melee max hit. Use your regular gear to attack two of the Dagannoth Kings until their health is below 50% of your melee max hit (below 20 hitpoints should be enough), then kill the third Dagannoth King. Then, quickly switch to your melee gear and kill the remaining two Kings with Voidwaker special attacks. They should die after one special attack hit each, completing the combat achievement.
Tribrid (Solo):
To complete this task you should first determine if it's better for you to use Magic or Ranged attacks. Based on your skill levels and gear either method could be more viable for you. For a Magic-based approach bring your strongest Barrage or Burst spell on the Ancient spellbook, and for a Ranged-based approach bring your strongest Chinchompa.
When gearing for this task take full tribrid gear including a non-AoE weapon for all combat styles. In addition, bring your AoE method of choice, whether that be the Magic- or Ranged-based approach. You may also consider bringing Justiciar equipment to tank the Melee and Ranged attacks while praying Protect from Magic.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Theatre of Blood Veteran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood 25 times. Hard Mode Theatre of Blood completions will also count towards this achievement.\nTheatre of Blood: Entry Mode does not count towards the completion of this achievement.

Theatre of Blood Master is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood 75 times. Hard Mode Theatre of Blood completions will also count towards this achievement.

Theatre of Blood Grandmaster is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood 150 times. Hard Mode Theatre of Blood completions will also count towards this achievement.

Two-Down is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Pestilent Bloat before he shuts down a third time.\nStrategy:\nThis achievement is very easy to accomplish as long as players are using the best strength gear they can afford, or elite void. Ideally some players should have the Scythe of Vitur, though players should have at least a crystal halberd, dragon claws, and a salve amulet (e) since the Bloat is susceptible to the amulet's effects.

Pop It is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Verzik without any Nylocas being frozen and without anyone taking damage from the Nylocas and without dying yourself.
Strategy:
This is best completed in a duo or trio encounter, to limit the amount of nylocas that spawns during the fight.
Nylocas Ischyros should be dealt with using a halberd, as it can potentially kill it without being in range for it to explode.
Nylocas Toxobolos and Nylocas Hagios can be killed from a distance with any weapon.
Alternatively, the player can simply avoid them by being at least four tiles away when they explode. However, this requires a bit more skill to pull off, since the AoE can be large enough to cause collateral to other players if improperly dodged.

A Timely Snack is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sotetseg after taking at least 3 ball attacks without sharing the damage and without anyone dying in the fight.\nStrategy:\nThe large red ball attack deals 121 damage if the damage is not shared, and is launched after every 10 direct magic attacks Sotetseg makes on the team. Simply tank the damage via tick-eating, though players should be wary of incoming projectiles to avoid being killed in the process.

Perfect Theatre is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood without anyone dying while qualifying for the completion of Perfect Maiden, Perfect Bloat, Perfect Nylocas, Perfect Sotetseg, Perfect Xarpus, and Perfect Verzik.
Strategy:
Perfect Theatre is considered one of the hardest grandmaster achievements in-game, as the task itself requires that all players complete their master variants at the same time. Even one simple mistake on any of these tasks will immediately disqualify the whole team, thus all players should have sufficient experience and know how to kill the bosses.
It is best to attempt this achievement in a trio scale, as it means less potential to make overall mistakes (as each additional player can potentially compound a mistake and thus disqualify the entire team), though this does mean the nylocas waves may be more tedious with a lack of chinchompas and barrage spells.
More in-depth advice on every relevant boss can be found under their own respective perfect pages, as listed above.

Perfect Maiden is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill The Maiden of Sugadinti without taking any damage off-prayer, from her blood splatter projectiles and Blood spawn trails along with letting a Nylocas Matomenos heal her.
Strategy:
Standing far away from the Maiden (or being able to predict when the blood splatter is launched) will prevent players from being damaged by the attack and minimise the chances of a blood spawn appearing. As the Maiden only attacks with magic, keeping Protect from Magic on will ensure that no off-prayer hits are received based on her aggro mechanics.
Groups of Nylocas Matamenos will appear when the Maiden reaches 70, 50, and 30% of her health for the first time. Using common freezing tactics for lone and bunched nylocas will help ensure that they can be bound and killed before they reach the Maiden. At the 30% interval, it is possible to skip killing them with very good DPS but should not be relied on.

Perfect Bloat is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Pestilent Bloat without anyone in the team taking damage from the following sources: Pestilent flies, Falling body parts or The Pestilent Bloats stomp attack.\nStrategy:\nPlayers should avoid immediately entering the arena if Bloat starts by moving north, as they will be flied upon entering the room. Players entering the room later should also wait until Bloat goes down the first time as he may occasionally send a fly from the far side due to line of sight.

Perfect Nylocas is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Nylocas Vasilias without anyone in the team attacking any Nylocas with the wrong attack style, without letting a pillar collapse and without getting hit by any of the Nylocas Vasilias attacks whilst off prayer.\nStrategy:\nUsing barrage spells or chinchompas is not recommended, so players will have to ensure they kill nylos quick enough that pillar health will not be a concern. Highlighting each nylo before you attack can help avoid accidental misclicks or a nylocas changing styles.

Perfect Sotetseg is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Sotetseg without anyone in the team stepping on the wrong tile in the maze, without getting hit by the tornado and without taking any damage from Sotetseg's attacks whilst off prayer.
Strategy:
The achievement requires players to avoid damage from wrong tiles during the maze mechanic and from Sotetseg's auto-attacks. Sotetseg will attack with all three combat styles, but with either melee or magic as a primary attack style. The magic attack will shatter into either another magic attack or a ranged one. If players are out of melee distance, Sotetseg will only use magic attacks. The melee attack will tend to hit before a ranged or magic hit, but because of its unpredictability, players can alternatively use a halberd or ranged weapons instead and attack from a distance, ensuring that the melee attacks are never used.
The charged ball can be shared or tick-eaten, but players can skip the attack by triggering the maze at 66% and 33% hp instead. Wait at around 70% and 40% hp until the ball is sent, then do enough damage to reach the threshold.
Make sure to Protect from Melee when exiting the maze to avoid accidentally taking a hit off prayer if selected by Sotetseg to enter the Shadow Realm.

Perfect Xarpus is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Xarpus without taking any damage from his attacks and without letting an exhumed heal him more than two times.
Strategy:
Learning how to handle exhumed is the only major roadblock in this achievement, as they are the only major issue due to how they spawn around Xarpus. It is recommended to try this in a trio encounter, as the exhumed will spawn significantly faster in 4 and 5-man encounters.
Landing defence draining specials from the bandos godsword and dragon warhammer are essential to completing the task. Players should ideally start together in one corner in a death-dot to minimise the amount of poison splatters across the arena. Each poison splatter has a 3x3 AoE, so it is important to stand two tiles away from the impact zone to avoid taking damage from it.
Once Xarpus is lowered to 25.0% of its health, it will screech and begin the next phase. It is important to watch where Xarpus is focusing at to avoid taking damage, after which the team should move to where he had just looked at as Xarpus can never look at the same direction twice in a row. Assuming that the players were ranging, they should not have any issue with any ragged tiles near him.

Perfect Verzik is a master combat achievement which requires the player to defeat Verzik Vitur without anyone in the team taking avoidable damage from Verzik Vitur's attacks.
Specifically, players are not allowed to take damage from:
- Magic and ranged attacks during phases 1 and 2
- Damage from pillar falling
- Nylocas explosions
- Verzik's bounce attack during phase 2
- If no damage is taken, this will not invalidate the run
- Ranged or magic attacks during phase 3 that are not correctly prayed against
- Being stuck in a web when it expires
- Yellow projectile when not shielded
- Green bomb attack without bouncing it to other players as many times as possible
- Verzik's Tornado attack
Players may take damage from:
- Nylocas Athanatos landing
- Lightning attack, it is allowed to tank the zap if the projectile immediately dissipates upon hitting the first player for a large amount of damage, or if the entire chain is handled correctly. However, letting the projectile correctly bounce on the first player and then incorrectly zap subsequent players for large amounts of damage will fail the task.
- Green bomb attack if it will continue to target another player or it cannot be bounced further
Strategy:
Phase 1:
No special considerations are needed for this phase as long as teams use enough Dawnbringer special attacks.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Can't Drain This is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill The Maiden of Sugadinti without losing any prayer points.
Strategy:
- Dodge the incoming attacks by moving your character before each attack to avoid blood splatters.
- Freeze or kill Blood spawns as quickly as possible.
- Flicking prayers can be used if done nearly perfectly to avoid losing any prayer points.
- Vengeance will help speed up the encounter, as many players will take high damage from Maiden's auto attacks which start with a max hit of 36.
- Avoid letting any Nylocas reach maiden, as each will raise her maximum hit by 3 or 4.
You will fail the achievement if you (or anyone on your team) stand in blood trails from her blood throw attack or from trails the blobs leave. This will fail the achievement even if you are at 0 prayer, making draining your prayer points before attempting this achievement not useful.
Can You Dance? is a master combat achievement requiring the player to kill Xarpus without anyone in the team using a ranged or magic weapon.

Morytania Only is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Theatre of Blood run using only Barrows brothers weapons, barring the Dawnbringer.
Strategy:
Players will be limited to Barrows weapons for their run. Non-barrows armour is permitted, though every room will be a significant struggle due to the slow speed and damage output of Barrows weapons. This achievement is possible in any team size, with 4-5 man being highly recommended. Lower team size completions are possible, but means a significant struggle.
Roles are fundamentally the same: Melee DPS, Range DPS, North Freeze and South Freeze, and each player performs the same actions as in regular runs while fighting The Maiden of Sugadinti and Nylocas Vasilias.
Meleers should opt for Guthan's Warspear with strongest melee gear available. Dharok's Greataxe with its respective full set results in higher damage output, however, it requires staying at lower HP thresholds. Rangers and magers are locked with Karil's crossbow and Ahrim's staff respectively.
One or two players should bring Serpentine helm to inflict poison to Nylocas Athanatos. An alternative poison method is casting Smoke spells, although this is highly inconsistent and less practical.
It is possible to bring runes for Surge spells and Vulnerability to considerably speed up the raid, which is only possible with Magic cape.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Back in My Day... is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Theatre of Blood raid without using a scythe of Vitur.
Strategy:
The next best option behind a scythe is the soulreaper axe, followed by a noxious halberd, blade of Saeldor, Osmumten's fang, and abyssal tentacle. Otherwise, the challenge is simply a matter of finding a team with no scythe-users or players willing to complete the achievement with you.
The player must survive the fight against Verzik or they will not obtain the achievement.
This achievement can be completed alongside Morytania Only.

Theatre (Duo) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood in a team of 2 players in less than 26 minutes.\nUnlike Tombs of Amascut, speed-based achievements for the Theatre of Blood count the challenge time rather than the overall time.

Theatre (Trio) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood in a team of three players in less than 20 minutes.\nUnlike Tombs of Amascut, speed-based achievements for the Theatre of Blood count the challenge time rather than the overall time.

Theatre (Trio) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood in a team of 3 players in less than 17 minutes and 30 seconds.\nUnlike Tombs of Amascut, speed-based achievements for the Theatre of Blood count the challenge time rather than the overall time.

Theatre (4-Scale) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood in a team of 4 players in less than 17 minutes.\nUnlike Tombs of Amascut, speed-based achievements for the Theatre of Blood count the challenge time rather than the overall time.\nLike other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

Theatre (4-Scale) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood in a team of 4 players in less than 15 minutes.\nUnlike Tombs of Amascut, speed-based achievements for the Theatre of Blood count the challenge time rather than the overall time.\nLike other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

Theatre (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood in a team of 5 players in less than 16 minutes.\nUnlike Tombs of Amascut, speed-based achievements for the Theatre of Blood count the challenge time rather than the overall time.\nLike other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

Theatre (5-Scale) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete the Theatre of Blood in a team of 5 players in less than 14 minutes and 15 seconds.\nUnlike Tombs of Amascut, speed-based achievements for the Theatre of Blood count the challenge time rather than the overall time.\nLike other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

Hazard Prevention is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil without it hitting anyone.
Strategy:
Step-under:
The achievement can be completed by hitting the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil and walking under it to avoid damage, then hitting it again, immediately teleporting out and running back to the cave. Setting NPC attack options to right-click, or using the shift-click walk under feature on the Menu Entry Swapper RuneLite plugin, makes this easier.
One-hit-per-trip:
This task can be easily achieved alongside Spec'd Out by teleporting to a player-owned house or Nardah and recharging special attack energy. If standing under the boss is too difficult, you can simply hit the boss once and immediately teleport after, but like above, the final attack must be registered while inside the room.
Freezing + outranging (Safespotting):
A less click-intensive method involves freezing the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil, preferably with Ice Barrage, and using a powered staff (e.g. the trident of the swamp) set to the Longrange attack style. Attack the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil four times from a distance. Before the effects of the freeze spell wear off, run out of the cave, re-enter and refreeze from max distance again, and attack four times.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Spec'd Out is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil using only special attacks.
Strategy:
Players can teleport out to recharge special attack energy (at a player-owned house's restoration pool or better, the Elidinis statuette in Nardah), and run back to the cave as many times as needed. The boss' health will not reset when you leave.
This achievement can be conveniently completed along with Hazard Prevention if the player walks under the Thermonuclear Smoke Devil after the first special attack and teleports out after the second.
Good weapons for this achievement include the Voidwaker, dragon claws, crystal halberds, and dragon daggers. The burning claws will disqualify the player as its burn effect is not considered special attack damage. Recoil from the ring of suffering and ring of recoil will also disqualify completion of the task.
Weapons that lower defence such as the Dragon Warhammer may be useful for speeding up the kill.
Venenatis Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Venenatis 10 times. Both Venenatis and her singles-plus variant Spindel kills count towards this task.
Venenatis Veteran is an elite combat achievement requiring the player to kill Venenatis 20 times. Both Venenatis and her singles-plus variant Spindel kills count towards this task.
Vet'ion Adept is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vet'ion 10 times. Both Vet'ion and his singles-plus variant Calvar'ion kills count towards this task.
Vet'eran is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vet'ion 20 times. Both Vet'ion and his singles-plus variant Calvar'ion kills count towards this task.

The Walk is a master combat achievement which requires the player to hit Vorkath 12 times during the acid special without getting hit by his rapid fire or the acid pools.
Strategy:
Completion of this achievement is calculated per acid phase, not per fight. As such, failing once does not prevent the player from attempting again during the same fight. Additionally, every attack counts towards the required 12; they do not need to deal damage.
There are two ways to complete the achievement; both require usage of the Woox Walk:
Ranged:
- Stand as far from Vorkath as your weapon range allows (leaving 4 rows between the player character and Vorkath, 3 rows between the character and the exit). A ranged weapon with a two-tick attack speed such as the toxic blowpipe or throwing darts is mandatory for this to work.
- Keep count of Vorkath's attacks, prepare to act on the seventh attack.
- On the same tick as he launches the special attack, move backwards one tile diagonally.
- At this point, there are two possible causes of failure: the special attack may have been a freezing attack, or acid may have landed on the tiles used for Woox-walking. In either case, it is still possible to complete the achievement in the next acid phase.
- Immediately begin Woox-walking by alternating clicks on Vorkath and backwards on every tick.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Zombie Destroyer is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath's zombified spawn without using crumble undead.
Strategy:
The easiest way to complete this step is to use Void Knight equipment, a salve amulet(ei) and a special attack of a dark bow with dragon arrows. Freezing spells will not work, and the delay between the spawn and the explosion is not long enough to get in multiple magic hits. Using a dark bow special attack will likely kill the spawn within just a few attempts. A Heavy ballista with dragon javelins is another good option. For ironmen, a Magic Shortbow (i) with rune or amethyst arrows is another option, as the Imbued version can spec twice before the spawn hits you.
If Vorkath is killed just as the spawn is launched, the freeze effect will wear off but the spawn will persist, allowing players to kite it if needed.

Dodging the Dragon is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath 5 times without taking any damage from his special attacks and without leaving his area.
Strategy:
The player must avoid Vorkath's special attacks for 5 kills in a row; taking damage from his special attacks and getting hit by the Zombified Spawn (regardless of the amount of damage it deals) will reset the streak and fail the task.
It is recommended to count Vorkath's attacks so the player is prepared to react accordingly; every 7th attack will be a special attack.
Acid Pool:
Start walking right when the acid shoots up in the air. The tile you're standing on will always be coated in acid, and it hits faster than you'd think given the animation.
Ranged Method:
The easiest, most consistent method is to remain 4 tiles north of the entrance during the initial 6 attacks, and evade the 7th acid pool attack by immediately moving to a tile adjacent to the entrance. Continue moving back and forth along the few tiles adjacent to the entrance to avoid Vorkath's rapid fireballs. The key to this strategy is the short line of tiles adjacent to the entrance which will never be covered by acid pools if you are not standing on them when the attack happens, allowing you to consistently avoid them. Be sure to move onto the tiles during the 7th attack and not start on them.
Melee Method:
This is harder than ranged.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Stick 'em With the Pointy End is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath using melee weapons only.
Strategy:
This achievement can be completed simultaneously along with The Fremennik Way.
This task can be easily completed using a melee-setup (can be done with any melee weapon). Do not equip a mage or ranged weapon to kill the undead spawn - just use the Crumble Undead spell on it without a magic weapon equipped. For more info see here.
It is worth using the spellbook filters to only show the combat spells and to have the Enable icon resizing option enabled; i.e. all the other spellbook options are disabled. The crumble undead spell icon will then be very large and this will prevent misclicks in the short time you have to attack the Zombified Spawn. Note if you are using a teleport spell to escape in case of problems you will want the teleport spells enabled as well which will add more icons to the spellbook display but should leave icons big.

Faithless Encounter is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath without losing any prayer points.
Strategy:
For players familiar with 1-tick prayer flicking, this achievement is straightforward. Otherwise, the player may simply not use prayers at all; the kill will be longer and more damage will be taken, but with high-end gear and high combat stats, this should not pose an issue. In this instance, be sure to use a shield that protects from dragonfire, as an antifire potion alone will still result in massive damage from Vorkath's dragonfire attacks, and it is not feasible to put prayer up to flick dragonfire attacks.
Resetting the kill until landing at least one defence-reducing special attack can significantly help in reducing the kill time, reducing the amount of damage that must be tanked. Wearing higher defence ranged gear such as Karil's or crystal will also help, if not flicking protection prayers.

The Fremennik Way is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath without any weapons.
Strategy:
This achievement can be completed simultaneously along with Stick 'em With the Pointy End.
The player is allowed to use armour (including a defender or a shield) for this task, any attack style , and use the Crumble Undead spell on the zombified spawn (though it must be manually cast on the spawn - equipping a slayer staff or casting a spell on Vorkath himself will fail the achievement). Note: Recoil damage will fail the achievement. A ring of suffering (ri) may be used for its defensive and prayer bonuses, but its recoil effect must be toggled off. When not dodging fireballs you should face hug Vorkath for maximum DPS and tank his melee attacks. It is recommended to maximize crush accuracy, strength bonus and to have a blue dragon or zombie task for the slayer helmet bonus – due to the lowered attack bonuses, a slayer helmet with an amulet of rancour is much more effective than a Neitiznot faceguard with a salve amulet. Attack style should be set to accurate, unless a max hit is gained from using aggressive.
, which has the same attack speed as an unarmed player.]]
It is also highly recommended that you know how to perform the Woox Walk before trying to do this task, as it will shorten the kill time.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Vorkath Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath in less than 1 minute and 15 seconds.\nStrategy:\nFor strategies on this achievement, see Vorkath Speed-Runner.

Vorkath Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath in less than 54 seconds.
Strategy:
Vorkath has 750 hitpoints, and this achievement is extremely notorious for the amount of damage needed in an exceedingly short amount of time. Avoid eating whenever possible; if absolutely necessary, use guthix rests or snowy knight mixes.
Thralls cannot be summoned within Vorkath's fight arena and Vorkath is also immune to all recoil damage, including Vengeance.
Vorkath has an attack speed of 5, or one attack every 3.0 seconds. A special attack is queued after six auto-attacks (18 seconds), of which he will either use Ice Dragonbreath or Rapid Fire. The former is generally recommended over the latter, since the special attack is quick to clear and allows players to resume dealing full damage to Vorkath. By the time the other special attack is queued, players will have a few seconds after it starts in order to meet the time. If the latter special attack starts, the player's damage will be reduced by 50% for the next ~15 or so seconds, and the time threshold is passed before the other special attack is used.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Extended Encounter is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vorkath 10 times without leaving his area.
Strategy:
Saradomin brews and super restore should fill the player's inventory instead of the typical solid food and prayer potions that would normally be brought, as Vorkath does not drop any unnoted food or potions to prolong trips.
If you're opting for a melee approach, here's a tried-and-tested strategy:
- Wear a slayer helmet and be on Slayer task to kill blue dragons.
- Equip an amulet of blood fury, which provides a passive chance for life leech on melee attacks.
- Utilise the special attack of the Bandos godsword to reduce Vorkath's Defence.
- Equip a dragon hunter lance, a fire or infernal cape, a Bandos chestplate or Torva platebody, Bandos tassets or Torva platelegs, a dragon or avernic defender, barrows or ferocious gloves, primordial boots or avernic treads, and a Berserker ring (i) or ultor ring.
- For consumables, bring 3 super combat potions, 1 extended anti-venom+, 1 extended super antifire, 1 prayer regeneration potion, 7-8 super restores, 11-12 Saradomin brews, and optionally a sanfew serum.
- After each kill, prioritise drinking your brews, super restores, and super combat potions to replenish your stats.
- During the acid phase, employ the "Woox walk" technique and remember to deactivate Protect from Magic.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)
Mummy! is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to heal a pyromancer with a rejuvenation potion after they have fallen.\nThis task can easily be done in an empty world.
Can We Fix It? is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to subdue the Wintertodt without allowing all 4 braziers to be broken at the same time.

Leaving No One Behind is a medium combat achievement which requires the player to subdue the Wintertodt without any of the pyromancers falling. It is only completed if at least 500 points are earned in the fight. This task can often be achieved passively by playing Wintertodt in the official Wintertodt worlds.
Strategy:
Actively attempting this task involves a lot of running, so it is recommended to wear weight-reducing clothing in slots not already filled with warm clothing. Stamina potions may be required if player has low Agility level. Prior to the round starting, collect several unfinished rejuvenation potions and harvest equal amount of bruma herbs from sprouting roots. Add herbs to unfinished potions and get ready for round to start by standing close to any of the four braziers. It might be helpful to choose either of the northern braziers, since there's often enough players at southern braziers keeping pyromancers healthy.
When the round starts light the closest brazier, chop bruma roots few times and add them to burning braziers. Run to all four pyromancers and use rejuvenation potions on them to heal them. Chop bruma roots again, add them to brazier and heal all pyromancers. Continue repeating that until the round ends making sure you finish with at least 500 points.

Why Fletch? is a hard combat achievement which requires the player to subdue the Wintertodt after earning 3000 or more points during the fight.
Strategy:
The player will need to attempt this in either a solo or small group scale setting, since the Wintertodt-designated worlds will always complete before the necessary points are acquired.
This will be a battle of attrition as the player will need to delay reducing Wintertodt's Energy levels to 0 for as long as possible to avoid completing the fight prematurely. In order to do so, the braziers will go largely under utilised, which will make Wintertodt a greater threat than it typically is.
Healing:
Prior to beginning the fight, make 8-10 rejuvenation potions in the lobby. Each dose restores 30% Warmth, meaning each potion restores a total of 120%. This will be more than enough for both the player and the pyromancers.
Points:
As the achievement name implies, Fletching isn't a bad way to gain the 3000 points needed for this achievement. The safest way to fletch is either stand by a single brazier in order to keep it lit for its damage reduction, or to position the player at the borderline between the safe entrance and the arena.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)
A Slithery Encounter is an easy combat achievement which requires the player to kill a wyrm requiring 62 Slayer. Killing a wyrmling will not count for this combat achievement.

Immortal Raider is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a solo Challenge Mode Chambers of Xeric without dying.\nThe achievement can be completed alongside Immortal Raid Team.

Chambers of Xeric: CM (Solo) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric: Challenge Mode (Solo) in under 45:00.\nStrategy:\nFor strategies on this achievement, see Chambers of Xeric: CM (Solo) Speed-Runner.

Chambers of Xeric: CM (Solo) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric: Challenge Mode (Solo) in under 38:30.
Strategy:
As with the normal mode variant of this achievement, the player must have extremely good gear in order to make the time required for this achievement.
While possible to obtain with no prep, this will require large amounts of purple sweets to consist of healing and run energy restore. It is possible to make the time with prep.
If you are on Arceuus, summon a thrall in every combat room and constantly use Death Charge. Tekton and Melee hand are only vulnerable to melee(zombie) thralls, Vasa and magic hand to magic(ghost) thralls, and head to ranged(skeleton) thralls. If you are on Lunars, Vengeance when you can.
Staying fully boosted through Overload and offensive prayers is vital in making time. Anytime you are attacking, post Tekton, be sure to be overloaded.
Overload boosts your stats every 15 seconds. Only brewing right before the 15 second intervals will ensure you are fully boosted throughout the raid. If you are in lethal range from unavoidable damage, such as the average muttadiles, and need to spam heal, try to restore back to full stats in time so you are fully boosted again on the interval.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Chambers of Xeric: CM (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric: Challenge Mode (5-scale) in under 30:00.\nLike other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

Chambers of Xeric: CM (5-Scale) Speed-Runner is a grandmaster combat achievement which requires the player to complete a Chambers of Xeric: Challenge Mode (5-scale) in under 25:00.\nLike other tasks requiring a specific number of players, this combat achievement is not required for Group Ironmen with a smaller group size.

Perfectly Balanced is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the Vanguards without them resetting their health.\nFor solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.

Together We'll Fall is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill all three Vanguards within ten seconds of killing the first one.
Strategy:
For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.
After the Vanguards are at critically low health and perform a shuffle, dump high-damaging attacks on them as the health threshold will no longer exist to force a heal. This task is best completed in group encounters. If attempting in a solo encounter, it is recommended to kill the melee, magic and then ranged Vanguard in that order. One effective tactic is to kill the magic vanguard and then use the Voidwaker special attacks to quickly dispose of the remaining two.

No Time for Death is a master combat achievement which requires the player to clear the tightrope room without killing any of the deathly mages or rangers.
Strategy:
Players will need to cross the tightrope, pick up the keystone crystal, return across the tightrope, and interact with the magic barrier to dispel it. The mages and rangers are unaggressive at first, but immediately attack anyone crossing the tightrope, resulting in a large stack of damage being applied at once. Dying does not fail the achievement; if a player dies with the keystone in their inventory, it drops to the floor where they died.
In groups, the mages and rangers should be distracted by other players to prevent them from attacking the crosser.
In solo encounters, it is recommended to maximise ranged defence and use Protect from Magic to minimise damage taken. Even though the deathly rangers have a higher max hit than the mages, they are far less accurate when wearing Torag's or Justiciar armour compared to the mages with Karil's or fortified Masori armour.
Using an anglerfish or a phoenix necklace can help survive the stack of damage when crossing. The achievement can be easily completed over multiple runs by moving the crystal as far as possible before dying, then returning and picking it up from the ground, repeating as necessary.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Putting It Olm on the Line is a master combat achievement which requires the player to complete a solo Chambers of Xeric raid with 40,000 or more points.
Challenge Mode cannot be used for this task.
Strategy:
The easiest way to get this achievement is to select a "Full" layout for all rooms. Otherwise, in order to get the minimum points needed for the achievement, the player will need to toggle large raids on as it ensures the first two floors are filled to the brim with four combat/puzzle rooms. As the points can be slow to obtain, players should take their time and prepare early to gain more points. Large raids can also cause duplicate puzzle rooms to appear on each floor.
If using a large layout, avoid the following rooms:
- Tekton, shamans, Jewelled Crabs - these rooms provide ~1,600 points.
Look for the following rooms:
- Vasa Nistirio - focus on the glowing crystals more than the boss, as they provide plenty of points. A good strategy is to reach the point cap on the glowing crystals then finish off the boss before leaving the room.
- Tightrope - each tightrope room provides ~4,000 points on average; double tightropes basically knock out 20% of the required total.
- Ice demon - gather 6 piles of kindling then light each brazier and double lighting two. This will yield ~6000 points before combat. A 7th pile will yield 50% points ~600.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Mutta-diet is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to kill the muttadiles without letting them heal from the meat tree.
Strategy:
For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.
It is possible to complete the achievement without cutting the tree. By using ice spells, or a Zamorak godsword the muttadiles can be frozen when they reach 50% hp. This stops them from reaching the tree if they can be killed quickly.
If chopping the tree instead, pray accordingly to the smaller muttadile's attacks as it will navigate around the tree to melee the player. Ensure the tree is completely chopped before the small muttadile reaches 50% hp.

Redemption Enthusiast is an elite combat achievement which requires the player to destroy the Abyssal portal without letting Vespula land.
Strategy:
Despite the name, redemption is not required to complete the achievement.
By attacking the portal, Vespula will fly into an enraged state and rapidly jab everyone next to her for heavy melee damage. Players underneath her will be spared from this attack, but she will apply rapid stomp damage dealing up to 8 damage per tick until they leave. By using Redemption with level 90 Hitpoints or higher, the player can use Redemption to restore health instead of using actual food. Using Redemption will drain all of the player's prayer points when they fall below 10% of their maximum Hitpoints level (9 or lower at level 90). To restore prayer, either drink prayer restoration potions or drink a dose of Prayer enhance (+). The latter has to be made with 78+ Herblore or be obtained as a drop from the magic vanguard, Tekton, or the Muttadiles. Set quick prayers to Redemption and magic/ranged boosting prayers depending on the combat style being used.
Attack the portal once and then run out of Vespula's melee range. The portal is 8 tiles away from the movable area and will require the use of the long range setting for crossbows and powered staves.
(More on the wiki page of this task.)

Stop Drop and Roll is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Vasa Nistirio before he performs his teleport attack for the second time.
Strategy:
For solo-run attempts, be sure raid scaling is set to "0" for the easiest fight, as scaling a raid to "1" doubles boss health.
Successful dragon warhammer or Bandos godsword hits will help increase the player's accuracy against Vasa. Use powerful ranged weapons to take him down as quickly as possible - either a twisted bow with dragon or amethyst arrows, a crystal armour set with the bow of Faerdhinen or a toxic blowpipe with dragon darts.
A strong stab weapon is also encouraged to deal with the glowing crystals quickly, as not disabling them fast enough will cause Vasa to perform his teleport attack. Vengeance at high health can be used against the teleport attack to rebound massive amounts of damage back onto him.

Anvil No More is a master combat achievement which requires the player to kill Tekton before he is able to use the anvil a second time.
Strategy:
Defence-draining weapons such as the bandos godsword or dragon warhammer are recommended for this achievement due to their accuracy and ability to hit high. Tekton will automatically return to the anvil if no one is in range when he scans or after attacking for a while, restoring some of his health and drained stats in the process. Try to avoid forcing Tekton returning to the anvil as it will reduce the amount of hits the team can land.
